description: Run a spot-only FX backtest using historical policy-rate-differential and/or lagged momentum signals. Downloads complete histories, verifies vintages and price coverage, and charges opening, rebalancing and closing costs. The carry signal does not include funding income or broker rollover. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

base.description: Base currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNH, CNY, DKK, EUR, GBP, HUF, ILS, JPY, KRW, MYR, NGN, NOK, NZD, PEN, SEK, THB, TWD, USD.

event_gated.description: When true, allow positions only after verified historical policy publications for either currency. This does not use future calendars or trade before a release.

event_window_days.description: Additional calendar days after the first UTC decision following publication; 0 permits that first day only.

momentum_lookback.description: Momentum lookback in observations for the momentum signal.

quote.description: Quote currency, 3-letter ISO code. Supported: AUD, BRL, CAD, CHF, CNH, CNY, DKK, EUR, GBP, HUF, ILS, JPY, KRW, MYR, NGN, NOK, NZD, PEN, SEK, THB, TWD, USD.

strategy.description: Signal mode: carry, momentum, or carry_momentum.

transaction_cost_bps.description: Per-side transaction cost in basis points applied on position changes.

name: fx_backtest_task
title: FX Backtest Task
